title: Closed support of proper pushforward lies in image
statement: Let Z be Noetherian, q : Y → Z proper, and F coherent on Y. If C is a closed subset equal to the support of F, then the support of q_*F is a closed subset D of Z contained in q(C).

source.place: Theorem 088E, support of H paragraph; Tag 02O5

proof.text: Since q is proper and Z Noetherian, Y is Noetherian. Proper coherent pushforward is coherent by Tag 02O5. On Z it is quasi-coherent of finite type by Tag 01XZ, so Tag 056J gives a closed support D.

Properness makes q(C) closed. For x outside q(C), put V = Z minus q(C). By hC every stalk of F on q inverse image V is zero. Any two sections on an open there have equal germs, hence agree locally and then globally by sheaf separatedness. Thus q_*F has singleton sections on every open inside V. Shrink a representative of any germ at x by intersecting with V; all such germs agree, so the pushforward stalk is zero. Contraposition gives D contained in q(C). This includes the zero module and empty source or target.

lean.statement:
theorem pushforward_support_closed_subset
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z]
    (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (F : CoherentModules Y)
    (C : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Y)
    (hC : (C : Set Y) = {x : Y | ¬ Subsingleton (F.obj.presheaf.stalk x)}) :
    ∃ D : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Z,
      (D : Set Z) =
        {x : Z | ¬ Subsingleton (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj).presheaf.stalk x)} ∧
      (D : Set Z) ⊆ q '' (C : Set Y)
